chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr and Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan and Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When you have finished the two rak'ahs, go to the Black Stone, kiss it and touch it, or gesture towards it, for it is necessary to do so."

And he said, "If you are able to drink from the water of Zamzam before you go out to al-Safa, then do so, and say when you drink: 'O Allah, make it beneficial knowledge, abundant sustenance, and healing from every disease and ailment.'"

He said, "And it has reached us that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said when he looked at Zamzam: 'If I were not to burden my ummah, I would take from it a measure or two measures.'"
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended rituals and supplications for the Black Stone and Zamzam water during Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the ritual sequence of Hajj, emphasizing the veneration of the Black Stone (Tawaf al-Qudum) and the spiritual benefits of drinking Zamzam water. It highlights the Prophet’s practical wisdom in limiting consumption to avoid burdening the community, a nuance preserved in Shia jurisprudence regarding the etiquette of pilgrimage.
